parameters.name: Always Cook
parameters.description: New in 2025.3: Forces cache to re-cook every frame regardless of input changes.

parameters.name: Active
parameters.description: When enabled, captures input POP frames

parameters.name: Active Pulse
parameters.description: Active for one frame, adds snapshot, discards oldest

parameters.name: Cache Size
parameters.description: Max snapshots to hold (oldest replaced when full)

parameters.name: Output Index
parameters.description: Index of POP to output (0=current, negative=past)

parameters.name: Interpolate Frames
parameters.description: Interpolate between cached frames (if same point count)

parameters.name: Reset
parameters.description: Resets cache and holds one snapshot

troubleshooting.solution: Check Active toggle is enabled and Cache Size > 0
Use Reset Pulse to clear cache and restart capture
Reduce Cache Size or increase Step Size to hold fewer frames
Cache POP doesn't fill gaps like Trail POP does

description: Receives POP data every frame and holds the most recent frames (up to Cache Size) in GPU memory. Outputs any held frame based on Output Index (time-delay). Cache Select and Cache Blend POPs can access combinations of held inputs for multi-frame blends.
